slides.title: Check your *cash.
slides.body: Everything in the business accounts today. Not invoices you hope get paid.

slides.title: Find your *monthly burn.
slides.body: Average what left the account over the last three months.

slides.title: *Divide.
slides.body: Cash divided by monthly burn = months of runway.

slides.title: Set your *line.
slides.body: Pick the number of months that makes you act. Decide it now, while you're calm.

slides.title: Revenue is a mood. *Runway is a fact.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
